summary.text: Web Roth (listed by Ballotpedia as Webster Roth) is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 79 who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a business owner from Winfield, Kansas, who formerly served as superintendent of the Kansas Soldiers' Home.

paragraphs.text: Webster Roth lives in Winfield, Kansas, and earned a B.S. in business quality management in 1996 and an M.B.A. in 2003, both from Southwestern College.
His career experience includes owning Roth Auction Service, working as a real estate agent and associate broker with Albright Realty, and serving as superintendent of the Kansas Soldiers' Home.
Roth assumed office in the Kansas House on January 9, 2023, succeeding Cheryl Helmer.
Siobhan McIntyre is the Democratic candidate for the seat in the November 2026 general election.
